question: how to post automatically from instagram to youtube
response_text:
For a content creator based in India (IN) looking to scale your reach by repurposing short-form content, cross-posting from Instagram Reels to YouTube Shorts is one of the most efficient growth strategies. Because Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts share a nearly identical vertical format (9:16) and short-form attention-span optimization, you can automate this pipeline to save hours of manual downloading and uploading.
